text-muted.$description: More contrast: secondary text as strong as body text

border.$description: More contrast: every outline at control strength (the theme's standard border-strong, 3:1 or more; read from the primitive because color.border-strong itself rises to text strength in this context)

border-strong.$description: More contrast: control outlines at text strength

border-group.$description: More contrast: a group drawn by its fill gains an outline at control strength (3:1), the theme's standard border-strong

border-control.$description: More contrast: outlines of filled controls at text strength, as border-strong

bg-control.$description: More contrast: controls sit on the raised surface; the strong outline marks them
